import openpyxl
from collections import defaultdict

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('tasks/3-59/testbed/data/score.xlsx')
ws = wb.active
rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
header = rows[0]
data = rows[1:]

print('Header:', header)
print('Number of records:', len(data))

# Compute overall stats
mid1 = [r[1] for r in data]
mid2 = [r[2] for r in data]
print('midterm1 avg:', sum(mid1)/len(mid1))
print('midterm2 avg:', sum(mid2)/len(mid2))
print('midterm1 max:', max(mid1), 'min:', min(mid1))
print('midterm2 max:', max(mid2), 'min:', min(mid2))

# Per student (aggregate by name)
students = defaultdict(list)
for name, m1, m2 in data:
    students[name].append((m1, m2))

print('\nPer student:')
for name in sorted(students):
    scores = students[name]
    avg1 = sum(s[0] for s in scores)/len(scores)
    avg2 = sum(s[1] for s in scores)/len(scores)
    print(f'{name}: count={len(scores)}, avg_mid1={avg1:.2f}, avg_mid2={avg2:.2f}')
EOF
python3 /tmp/analyze.py"}
